description:
1. The agent must locate the skill at skills/meeting-to-kanban/ and read resources/board-columns.yaml to discover the canonical column schema (Backlog, Next, Doing, Waiting, Done), the 'unresolved' default marker for missing owners/dates, the '[ASSUMPTION]' prefix for notes, and the 'OPEN:' marker for open questions.
2. The agent must invoke scripts/tasks_to_kanban.py with the correct CLI flags: --transcript, --columns-schema, --output-csv, --output-summary, --output-owners, --output-questions, --project-name, and --time-horizon.
3. The resulting kanban_board.csv must have all seven required columns (task_id, title, column, owner, due_date, blockers, notes), use only the five valid column labels from the YAML schema, mark missing owners and due dates as the string 'unresolved' (not blank/null/N/A), and include '[ASSUMPTION]' notes on those tasks.
4. manager_summary.md must contain a substantive multi-sentence overview referencing task counts and unresolved items.
5. owners_table.md must list task IDs alongside owner names.
6. open_questions.md must contain lines prefixed with 'OPEN:' as mandated by the output schema.
7. The CSV must reflect both 'Done' (the completed de-identification pipeline) and 'Waiting' (blocked items like the DBA approval and labelled dataset review), and must capture at least one blocker string.
The key traps: using wrong column names (e.g., 'Todo', 'In Progress'), leaving owner/date blank instead of writing 'unresolved', omitting the [ASSUMPTION] notes, missing the OPEN: prefix, and failing to produce all four output artifacts.
